items.title: BAV HI-END SHOW 2026
items.summary: Meet Louis Desjardins, CEO, Founder and Head Designer of Kronos Audio, at BAV HI-END SHOW 2026 in Bangkok.
items.imageAlt: Louis Desjardins of Kronos Audio featured as a special guest at BAV HI-END SHOW 2026

venue.name: Bangkok Marriott Marquis Queen's Park Hotel

body: Kronos Audio is pleased to join BAV HI-END SHOW 2026 in Bangkok from August 28–30, 2026.
Meet our special guest, Louis Desjardins, CEO, Founder and Head Designer of Kronos Audio, and experience a carefully selected system featuring exceptional ultra-high-end audio components.
We look forward to welcoming visitors for three days of music, discovery and uncompromising analogue playback.
